name: shadcn/ui
subtitle: Copy-into-your-project React components
creator: shadcn
description: A collection of accessible, good-looking React components that you copy into your own codebase with a CLI, rather than installing as a locked package. Built on Tailwind CSS and headless primitives, so you can edit everything.

codeSamples.label: Shell + TSX

pros: You own and can edit every component
Looks polished out of the box
cons: React only (community ports for Vue and Svelte)
